questions.stem:
Define standard electrode potential. Calculate the standard electrode potential of the following cell :
\(\mathrm{Zn / Zn^{2+} \parallel Cu^{2+} / Cu}\) when
\(E^0_{(\mathrm{Zn^{+}/Zn})} = -0.76\ \mathrm{V}\) and \(E^0_{(\mathrm{Cu^{2+}/Cu})} = +0.34\ \mathrm{V}\).

hi.stem:
मानक इलेक्ट्रोड विभव की परिभाषा लिखिए तथा निम्नलिखित सेल के मानक e.m.f. की गणना कीजिए :
\(\mathrm{Zn / Zn^{2+} \parallel Cu^{2+} / Cu}\) जबकि
\(E^0_{(\mathrm{Zn^{+}/Zn})} = -0.76\ \mathrm{V}\) तथा \(E^0_{(\mathrm{Cu^{2+}/Cu})} = +0.34\ \mathrm{V}\)

questions._flag: Both languages print the zinc couple as Zn⁺/Zn (meant Zn²⁺/Zn), kept as printed; the English asks for the cell's 'standard electrode potential' where the Hindi asks for its standard e.m.f.

questions.stem:
Explain molar conductivity. The resistance of cell filled with \(0.02\ \mathrm{mol\ L^{-1}}\) \(\mathrm{KCl}\) solution is \(480\ \Omega\). Calculate the molar conductivity of the solution.
(Cell constant = \(1.29\ \mathrm{cm^{-1}}\)).

hi.stem: मोलर चालकता को समझाइए। \(0.02\ \mathrm{mol\ L^{-1}}\) \(\mathrm{KCl}\) विलयन भरे सेल का प्रतिरोध \(480\ \Omega\) है, तो विलयन की मोलर चालकता ज्ञात कीजिए। (सेल स्थिरांक = \(1.29\ \mathrm{cm^{-1}}\))

questions.stem: Write unit of first order reaction. The initial concentration of \(\mathrm{N_2O_5}\) at 318 K was \(0.60 \times 10^{-2}\ \mathrm{mol\ L^{-1}}\) in the first order reaction, \(\mathrm{N_2O_{5(g)} \longrightarrow 2NO_{2(g)} + \frac{1}{2}O_{2(g)}}\), which became \(0.20 \times 10^{-2}\ \mathrm{mol\ L^{-1}}\) after 60 minutes. Calculate the velocity constant at 318 K. (log 3 = 0.4771)

hi.stem: प्रथम कोटि की अभिक्रिया की इकाई लिखिए। प्रथम कोटि की अभिक्रिया \(\mathrm{N_2O_{5(g)} \longrightarrow 2NO_{2(g)} + \frac{1}{2}O_{2(g)}}\) में 318 K पर \(\mathrm{N_2O_5}\) की प्रारंभिक सान्द्रता \(0.60 \times 10^{-2}\ \mathrm{mol\ L^{-1}}\) थी जो 60 मिनट के उपरान्त \(0.20 \times 10^{-2}\ \mathrm{mol\ L^{-1}}\) रह गई। 318 K पर वेग स्थिरांक की गणना कीजिए। (log 3 = 0.4771)

questions._flag: Both languages ask for the 'unit of first order reaction' (presumably of its rate constant), kept as printed.
